_comment: Player valuation configuration - market value, replacement levels, scarcity, and team impact

value_curve._comment: Non-linear curve for converting evaluation scores to market values

tiers._comment: Below-average players (0-60): Low multiplier, linear growth
Average to above-average players (60-75): Moderate exponential growth
Good to very good players (75-85): Stronger exponential growth
Elite players (92-100): Extreme exponential growth - superstars are worth much more

value_curve._elite_threshold_comment: Score at which elite multiplier boost is applied

replacement_levels._comment: Baseline talent available at league minimum cost by position. Lower values = harder to find quality replacements (scarce). Higher values = easier to replace (abundant).
replacement_levels._QB_comment: Quarterbacks - scarce position, hard to find quality backups
replacement_levels._RB_comment: Running backs - abundant position, easy to replace
replacement_levels._OL_comment: Offensive line - thin depth, hard to find quality replacements
replacement_levels._EDGE_comment: Edge rushers - very scarce, elite pass rushers are rare
replacement_levels._LB_comment: Linebackers - more available than premium positions
replacement_levels._CB_comment: Cornerbacks - scarce position, good corners are hard to find

scarcity._comment: Supply/demand multipliers for positional scarcity. Calculated from starter slots needed vs available above-replacement players.
scarcity._scarcity_min_comment: Minimum multiplier when supply exceeds demand (abundant position)
scarcity._scarcity_max_comment: Maximum multiplier when demand exceeds supply (scarce position)

starter_slots._comment: Number of starters needed per team at each position. Total demand = slots × 32 teams.

team_impact._comment: Depth and positional importance for team-specific value. Measures how valuable a player is to their current team based on roster composition.
team_impact._no_backup_multiplier_comment: Value multiplier when team has no backup at the position (critical roster need)
team_impact._thin_depth_multiplier_comment: Value multiplier when team has only one backup at the position

position_win_impacts._comment: Win impact weight by position. Based on NFL analytics of how each position contributes to team success.
position_win_impacts._QB_comment: Quarterback has outsized impact on wins - most important position
position_win_impacts._EDGE_comment: Elite pass rushers significantly impact wins
position_win_impacts._CB_comment: Cornerbacks are critical in pass-heavy league
position_win_impacts._WR_comment: Wide receivers are important offensive weapons
position_win_impacts._OL_comment: Offensive line is foundational but less visible
position_win_impacts._S_comment: Safeties are versatile but less impactful than CBs
position_win_impacts._TE_comment: Tight ends are useful but not game-changing
position_win_impacts._RB_comment: Running backs are more replaceable in modern game
position_win_impacts._K_comment: Kickers have minimal impact on wins (except clutch moments)
position_win_impacts._P_comment: Punters have minimal impact on wins (field position matters less)

market._comment: Contract range variance for negotiation. Determines how much contract offers can vary around estimated value.
market._range_spread_pct_comment: Contract range = est_value ± (est_value × 0.15). A player worth $10M would have range $8.5M-$11.5M.

position_premiums._comment: DEPRECATED: Use position_weights in contract_valuation.json. Kept for backward compatibility with ContractValuation.gd.

_age_multipliers_comment: DEPRECATED: Use age_multipliers in contract_valuation.json. Array format kept for backward compatibility with ContractValuation.gd.

current_vs_potential._comment: DEPRECATED: Contract blending of current vs potential stats. Kept for backward compatibility with ContractValuation.gd.

score_to_value._comment: DEPRECATED: Simple linear score-to-value conversion. Use value_curve instead. Kept for backward compatibility.

_jitter_sigma_pct_comment: DEPRECATED: Random variance for contract values. Kept for backward compatibility with ContractValuation.gd.
